name: Blessings
overview: Scripture reveals that blessings are divine favors bestowed by God upon those who trust Him, obey His commandments, and live righteously. The Psalms emphasize that the truly blessed are those whose sins are forgiven and who place their trust in the Son, while Numbers 6:24 expresses God's desire to bless and protect His people. Deuteronomy 28:1 highlights that diligent obedience leads to exaltation above nations, and Job 42:12 illustrates God's abundant restoration and blessing following faithfulness amid trials.
